strategy.offer: Packaged charcuterie and cold-cut specialties, including sausages, hams, salami, aspic items, pâtés, and organic variants.
strategy.customers: Households and retail food shoppers seeking flavorful, convenient meat specialties, including organic and more ingredient-conscious options.
strategy.why_we_win: They expect success through trusted taste and quality from careful craftsmanship, premium ingredients, traditional recipes, and broad variety.
strategy.resources: Selected raw materials, in-house seasoning expertise, traditional processing know-how, curing and maturation capabilities, and trained employees support the business.
strategy.direction: Expanding the assortment, especially organic lines and new formats, while investing in apprenticeships and future workforce development.
